sentences.text: Leaned Advocate Mr. P. B. Velani appearing on behalf of Respondent No. 2 (Original Complainant), who is present before this Court, has placed on record duly sworn in Affidavit dated 21.02.2026.
The same is ordered to be taken on record.
Learned Advocate has submitted that matter has been amicably settled between the parties and there is no objection if present application is allowed.

The affidavit reads thus:
"I, Avaniben D/o Dipeshbhai Purohit, Aged about 31 Years, Occupation: Service &
Housewife, Residing at:
Rachana Society, Behind Excellence Hotel, Deesa-Palanpur Highway at: Deesa, Tal:
Deesa, Dist: Banaskantha, Mob. No.7600383593, do hereby solemnly affirm and state on oath as under:-
1. I say that a Criminal complaint being F.I.R.
No.11195006210027/2021 is registered by me at Mahila Police Station, Palanpur, District Banaskantha against the petitioners (original accused).
2. I state that after filling of the aforesaid F.I.R. pursuant thereto, an amicable settlement is arrived at between the parties of the aforesaid F.I.R.
3.

I state now I have no grievance with regard to the aforesaid F.I.R. and I do not wish to continue with the aforesaid F.I.R. and I have no objection if the impugned. F.I.R. as well as all proceedings initiated pursuant thereto are quashed.
4 I say that on certain misunderstandings between Me and Orig. Accused I have filed complaint against the petitioners-Orig. Accused.
I say that the dispute was with the petitioners are for Civil dispute.
I say that the dispute is resolved with the petitioners.
The Petitioners No.1 and I had agreed to reside with together and we are Husband & Wife.
There are no dispute with each other.
NEUTRAL CITATION R/SCR.A/2810/2026 ORDER DATED: 25/02/2026 undefined 5.
I state that the present compromise is arrived at without any coercion, force or undue influence.

Solemnly affirmed at Ahmedabad on this 20th Day of February, 2026."
6.
Considering averments made in the Affidavit as also the submissions made by the learned Advocates for the respective parties, the present Application deserves to be allowed and is hereby allowed.
The FIR No.11195006210027 of 2021 registered with Mahila Police Station, Palanpur
is hereby quashed and set aside.
Rule is made absolute to the aforesaid extent.

(M. R. MENGDEY,J) NABILA Parth Girishkumar Joshi vs State Of Gujarat on 25 February, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/10881027/
